reasoning_content:
Both build and dev server work. Let me also verify the masterportal.js loads properly by checking with curl the served index. The HTTP 200s confirm the built artifacts and dev server are functioning. Let me kill the dev server and http-server to clean up. Also verify the JS bundle content briefly.

Let me kill processes.

action.command: ps aux | grep -E "vite|http-server" | grep -v grep | awk '{print $2, $11, $12, $13}'; pkill -f "devtools/vite.config.js" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "http-server" 2>/dev/null; sleep 2; echo "cleaned"; ps aux | grep -E "vite|http-server" | grep -v grep | wc -l
